overview: Flow2GAN proposes a two-stage framework that first trains an audio generation model with improved Flow Matching (endpoint estimation + spectral energy-adaptive loss scaling) on a multi-resolution ConvNeXt-based Fourier coefficient network, then fine-tunes few-step generators via GAN adversarial learning to achieve high-fidelity few-step audio generation from Mel-spectrograms or discrete audio tokens.

modules.name: Audio Data Preprocessing
modules.description: Handles raw audio loading, resampling to target sample rate, Mel-spectrogram extraction (with configurable FFT/hop/Mel bins), and Encodec audio token encoding at variable bandwidths, producing conditioning representations for both training modes.

modules.name: Multi-Resolution STFT/ISTFT Processing
modules.description: Implements differentiable multi-resolution Short-Time Fourier Transform and Inverse STFT operations at three time-frequency resolutions, converting between waveform domain and complex Fourier coefficient domain with concatenated real/imaginary components for each branch.

modules.name: Condition Encoder
modules.description: Implements a ConvNeXt-based encoder that extracts deep conditional features from input Mel-spectrograms or Encodec token embeddings, producing shared generation conditions reused across all multi-resolution branches and multiple sampling steps during Flow Matching inference.

modules.name: Multi-Resolution ConvNeXt Backbone
modules.description: Implements the three-branch network architecture where each branch processes Fourier coefficients at a distinct time-frequency resolution using ConvNeXt layers (with BiasNorm and PreLU activation), using larger embedding dimensions for low-frame-rate branches and smaller for high-frame-rate branches, with branch outputs summed for final waveform reconstruction.

modules.name: Improved Flow Matching Objective
modules.description: Implements the reformulated Flow Matching training objective that predicts the clean endpoint x1 instead of velocity vt, with the simplified loss omitting the 1/(1-t)^2 weighting factor, providing a consistent learning objective that handles both active and empty (silent) audio regions.

modules.name: Spectral Energy-Adaptive Loss Scaling
modules.description: Implements the perceptually-aware loss scaling mechanism that converts prediction errors to the frequency domain via power STFT with linear filterbank smoothing, then scales element-wise inversely by the square root of the reference spectrogram energy (clamped for stability), emphasizing perceptually salient low-energy spectral regions across both time and frequency dimensions.

modules.name: Few-Step Generator Construction
modules.description: Constructs few-step generators by forwarding the trained Flow Matching model through N steps using the modified Euler sampling rule that incorporates endpoint prediction, with gradients backpropagated through all forward passes for end-to-end optimization, producing separate 1-step, 2-step, and 4-step generator models.

modules.name: Multi-Period and Multi-Resolution Discriminators
modules.description: Implements the Multi-Period Discriminator (MPD) that analyzes different periodic waveform patterns and the Multi-Resolution Discriminator (MRD) that operates in the time-frequency domain across multiple spectral resolutions, jointly capturing diverse audio features for adversarial training.

modules.name: GAN Fine-Tuning with Combined Losses
modules.description: Implements the second training stage combining HingeGAN adversarial loss from MPD/MRD, L1 feature matching loss from discriminator intermediate layers, and multi-scale L1 Mel-spectrogram reconstruction loss with varied window/hop/Mel configurations, with optional Gaussian noise injection to conditioning log-Mel for robustness.

modules.name: Flow Matching Sampling and Inference Pipeline
modules.description: Implements the full inference workflow including noise initialization, multi-step Euler ODE solving with the endpoint-prediction reformulated update rule, condition encoder single forward pass with feature caching across steps, and ISTFT-based final waveform synthesis from multi-resolution branch outputs.

modules.name: Objective Evaluation Metrics Suite
modules.description: Implements all objective evaluation metrics used in the paper: PESQ (Perceptual Evaluation of Speech Quality), ViSQOL, V/UV F1 score for voiced/unvoiced classification, periodicity error, and Fréchet Speech Distance (FSD) using Wav2Vec2-based feature space, computed on both LibriTTS and universal audio test sets.

modules.name: Subjective Evaluation and TTS Integration
modules.description: Implements subjective evaluation protocols including Similarity MOS (SMOS) and naturalness MOS, and integrates Flow2GAN as a vocoder with F5-TTS for zero-shot TTS evaluation on LibriSpeech-PC, computing WER, speaker similarity (WavLM ECAPA-TDNN cosine similarity), and UTMOS naturalness scores.

modules.name: Ablation Study and Comparison Framework
modules.description: Implements controlled ablation experiments comparing standard vs. endpoint-prediction Flow Matching, with/without spectral energy scaling vs. per-frame scaling, with/without the 1/(1-t)^2 loss factor, single-resolution vs. multi-resolution network, with/without condition encoder, pure GAN vs. two-stage training, and comparison against Shortcut models, plus SOTA benchmarking against BigVGAN, Vocos, RFWave, PeriodWave-Turbo, and WaveFM.

modules.name: Inference Speed Benchmarking and Experiment Management
modules.description: Implements computational efficiency measurement as real-time factor (xRT) on both CPU and GPU with standardized batch size and segment length, along with configuration management (model architectures, training hyperparameters, loss scaling parameters), experiment logging, checkpoint persistence, and result aggregation for automated table generation.
